production_scope: goodeasy landing keyboard only, 8 files; no episode body or VISUAL root landing edits
decisions: VISUAL landing: small content-discovery entry at PC upper right/mobile lower right, no new top section. Situations are reader-provided text/chips plus editor-defined topics, not inferred private user profiling.

Remove article-curtain UI and execution. Preserve owner-requested bar-climb and side-peek in the local sample. Do not treat GPT's objection to all playful motion as authority to remove approved features.
Goodeasy: guide the next actionable control, not pretend to understand the whole 3D model. First production scope is the keyboard landing input then explicit next-link help.

Use a real failed attempt signal: two valid short case hits within six seconds without a successful input. Background misses, drags, multi-touch, scrolling, long presses and lost WebGL contexts do not count.
No timer-only confusion inference. Offer once per tab session; closed/manual-toggle-close suppresses later automatic help. Reduced motion uses manual static help only.
Input success hides the guide immediately. Do not pop another tour over typing. Further next-link pointing requires the reader to request it.
Manual help uses visible call-button text if safe overlay placement fails; no forced scrolling. Focus changes only through explicit move buttons or restoration when a focused guide closes.
Keep sound enabled/disabled information visible when the existing status slot is temporarily used. Two lines distinguish action from sound state. Inline focus outlines draw inside the box.
No new backend, LLM, API router or analytics events. Only four booleans are kept in sessionStorage. Input text and pointer coordinates are not saved or transmitted by the guide.
